# math

Deterministic math helpers. `math.random()` is seeded per run, so a backtest repeats exactly.

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`math.abs()`](#math-abs) | Absolute value. |
| [`math.max()`](#math-max) | Largest of the arguments. |
| [`math.min()`](#math-min) | Smallest of the arguments. |
| [`math.floor()`](#math-floor) | Rounds down to a whole number. |
| [`math.ceil()`](#math-ceil) | Rounds up to a whole number. |
| [`math.round()`](#math-round) | Rounds to `digits` decimals (default 0). |
| [`math.sqrt()`](#math-sqrt) | Square root. |
| [`math.pow()`](#math-pow) | `x` to the power `y`. |
| [`math.log()`](#math-log) | Natural logarithm. |
| [`math.exp()`](#math-exp) | e to the power `x`. |
| [`math.random()`](#math-random) | seeded; seed is part of the run config |

```ts

```

Absolute value.
